cmd:
bash -c 
echo "=== 1. Master Bindings transform_spec ==="
docker exec gpay-postgres-cdc psql -U postgres -d cdc_system_db -Atc "SELECT id, master_schema, master_table, transform_spec::text FROM cdc_system.master_binding WHERE is_active = true ORDER BY id;"
echo "=== 2. Shadow (_source_id) vs Master (_id) HashWindow & Count Comparison ==="
docker exec gpay-postgres-shadow psql -U postgres -d cdc_shadow_db -Atc "SELECT 'shadow.payment_bills', COUNT(*), COALESCE(BIT_XOR(('x' || SUBSTR(MD5(\"_source_id\"::text || '|' || \"_source_ts\"::text), 1, 16))::bit(64)::bigint), 0) FROM shadow_traitestpbs.payment_bills WHERE NOT COALESCE(\"_deleted\", false);"
docker exec gpay-postgres-dest psql -U postgres -d cdc_master_db -Atc "SELECT 'master.payment_bills', COUNT(*), COALESCE(BIT_XOR(('x' || SUBSTR(MD5(\"_id\"::text || '|' || \"_source_ts\"::text), 1, 16))::bit(64)::bigint), 0) FROM master_payment_bill_service.payment_bills WHERE NOT COALESCE(\"_deleted\", false);"
docker exec gpay-postgres-dest psql -U postgres -d cdc_master_db -Atc "SELECT 'master.payment_bills_1', COUNT(*), COALESCE(BIT_XOR(('x' || SUBSTR(MD5(\"_id\"::text || '|' || \"_source_ts\"::text), 1, 16))::bit(64)::bigint), 0) FROM master_payment_bill_service.payment_bills_1 WHERE NOT COALESCE(\"_deleted\", false);"
